findings.gist: check_code_claims.py runs NUM_RE (\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?) against the raw undecoded text column of candidates_comlab.csv. In 44 KG claims where the source JSON uses \u00b1, \u2013, \u2212, or \u2192 immediately before digits (e.g. \u00b15, 2000\u20133000, < \u221210, 0\u219212V), NUM_RE concatenates the hex code digits onto the claim number (yielding 15, 20133000, 221210, 219212) so the real number is absent from nums(c['text']). Spec R7 mandates clean UTF-8 values, codeaudit/README.md requires the numeric value as written, and the spec forbids editing check_code_claims.py, candidates_comlab.csv, or kg/*.json — so no compliant CSV edit can pass Verification step 1.
